learning_outcomes.text: Knows the fundamental principles of mechanical systems operation and manufacturing technological processes.
Understands methods of constructive-functional analysis and quality requirements applicable in the mechanical industry.
Knows occupational safety regulations and specific PSI instructions for working with mechanical equipment.
Understands the use of simulation software for calculating, dimensioning, and verifying mechanical components.
Is able to perform diagnostic and maintenance operations on real mechanical equipment and systems.
Applies optimization analysis methods for technological processes and mechanical components.
Uses measuring equipment and simulation programs to verify functional parameters.
Drafts technical reports and documentation related to practice activities, in accordance with professional standards.
Demonstrates autonomy in performing practical tasks, respecting work procedures and safety regulations.
Is able to plan and individually manage diagnostic, technical maintenance, and reporting activities.
Shows responsibility in the use of equipment and resources, ensuring the quality and safety of operations performed.
Integrates efficiently into multidisciplinary teams, respecting the ethical and collaborative principles of the profession.

syllabus_topics: Occupational safety, general instructions, specific instructions for the practice location, PSI instructions
Preparation of the organizational sketch of the practice location. Presentation of the company.
Description of technological processes in the sectors where the practice takes place.

Constructive-functional analysis of technological lines, mechanical transmissions in the construction of road vehicles, thermal equipment, mechatronic equipment, and robots. Preparation of kinematic diagrams.
Knowledge of the main types of mechanical processing.
General aspects regarding the use of calculation programs in the design of mechanical and mechatronic systems within the company or firm.
teaching_methods: Applied demonstrations on mechanical equipment and systems
Case studies for analyzing technological processes and optimizing equipment function
Working with specific software for verifying functional parameters
Documentation of results in technical reports

assessment_methods.method: Practice report (oral presentation to the practice supervisor)

assessment_rules: The final evaluation result is based on the weighted scores of each activity. Grades are awarded from 1 to 10. A grade of 5 certifies the acquisition of minimal learning outcomes and the granting of associated study credits.
